title: Standalone Lydite v0.0.4 template branch
summary: Veraphify has a separate Lydite-Test-Vault branch whose import tree is exactly the pinned upstream Lydite v0.0.4 tree.
acceptance_criteria: The branch begins with a parentless empty tree and its next commit imports the complete upstream tree byte-for-byte.

testing.scope: Git tree identity and history inspection of the standalone template

evidence.claim: The upstream source commit has the identical Git tree.
Empty root of the permanent branch.

The branch tip adds project-specific proof planning after the exact upstream import.
